SELECT * FROM transactions_1k WHERE CustomerID = 38508 LIMIT 5
SELECT * FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = 38508 AND Date = '201201'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM transactions_1k WHERE CustomerID = 38508

SELECT (SELECT SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) FROM transactions_1k t WHERE t.CustomerID = '38508') AS gas_station_spent, (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) FROM yearmonth y WHERE y.CustomerID = '38508' AND y.Date = '201201') AS january_2012_spent;

SELECT P.ID, P.Birthday, E."Symptoms", E."Diagnosis", P."Diagnosis" AS PatientDiagnosis, E."Examination Date"
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE E."Symptoms" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC, E."Examination Date" DESC
LIMIT 10
SELECT E."Symptoms", E."Diagnosis" FROM Examination AS E INNER JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID WHERE E."Symptoms" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY P."Birthday" DESC, E."Examination Date" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT r.name
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Alex' AND d.surname = 'Yoong'
  AND q.position < 20
ORDER BY r.year, r.round;
SELECT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T3.name FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId WHERE T1.forename = 'Alex' AND T1.surname = 'Yoong' AND T2.position < 20 ORDER BY T3.year, T3.round

SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, MIN(r.year) AS first_year FROM drivers d JOIN results res ON d.driverId = res.driverId JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'

SELECT r.name, res.points FROM results AS res INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverId = d.driverId INNER JOIN races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND r.year = (SELECT MIN(r2.year) FROM results AS res2 INNER JOIN drivers AS d2 ON res2.driverId = d2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS r2 ON res2.raceId = r2.raceId WHERE d2.forename = 'Lewis' AND d2.surname = 'Hamilton') ORDER BY r.round ASC, r.date ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT Id, Title FROM posts WHERE Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
SELECT Id, PostHistoryTypeId, UserId, CreationDate, Comment FROM postHistory WHERE PostId = 118 ORDER BY CreationDate

SELECT c.Text FROM comments AS c WHERE c.UserId IN (SELECT DISTINCT ph.UserId FROM postHistory AS ph INNER JOIN posts AS p ON ph.PostId = p.Id WHERE p.Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?' AND ph.PostHistoryTypeId IN (4, 5)) ORDER BY c.Id
SELECT DISTINCT fd.language, fd.name, c.setCode, c.name FROM cards AS c INNER JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND fd.language = 'Korean';
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cards AS c INNER JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND fd.language = 'Korean') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS answer;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, MIN(date), MAX(date) FROM trans WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM trans WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, MIN(date), MAX(date) FROM trans WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31';

SELECT DISTINCT C.client_id FROM trans AS T INNER JOIN account AS A ON T.account_id = A.account_id INNER JOIN disp AS D ON A.account_id = D.account_id INNER JOIN client AS C ON D.client_id = C.client_id WHERE T.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND T.date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31' AND D.type = 'OWNER' AND T.amount < (SELECT AVG(T2.amount) FROM trans AS T2 WHERE T2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND T2.date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31') ORDER BY C.client_id
